body:
ACCOUNT SUMMARY
- Enterprise prospect (EU-based digital bank) evaluating Redwood Inference for a customer-support assistant + internal investigation summarization.
- Hard requirement: EU-only processing + EU-only storage/logging for in-scope data. Explicitly called out: prompts, completions, embeddings payloads, request metadata, traces, audit logs, optional persistence artifacts.
- Second hard requirement: SIEM-ready audit logs (Splunk + Microsoft Sentinel). Wants "proof" events + field mapping and retention details.

FIRMOGRAPHICS / CONTEXT
- Primary team: Customer Ops + Fraud Investigations, with Platform Security gating procurement.
- Target scale (from calls): ~25–40 RPS peak for chat during business hours, ~2–5M tokens/day initially. Latency target: p95 < 900ms for short turns; willing to trade a bit of latency for strict residency.
- Model stance: open-model friendly (prefers avoiding single-vendor dependency). OK with Redwood catalog as long as versions can be pinned and quality regressions are monitored.

WHAT THEY WANT FROM REDWOOD
- Hosted API pilot in EU region (they repeatedly said: "EU-only means EU-only, including logs"), with a path to Dedicated EU once usage is validated.
- Region pinning controls at org/project level:
  - pinned_region=eu-west
  - allowed_regions=[eu-west] (no cross-region failover)
- Deterministic routing: no cross-region fallback unless explicitly approved + fully auditable.
- Audit logs:
  - Needs event types for allow/deny decisions (policy evaluated) + violations.
  - Must include: timestamp, org_id/tenant, project/workspace, requested_region, evaluated_region, decision (allow/deny), decision_reason, policy_source, request_id/trace_id, actor (api_key/client/app), SDK region hint (if provided), and export status.
  - Wants examples and confirmation exporter supports Splunk HEC + Sentinel (or at minimum JSON over S3 + forwarder).

SECURITY REVIEW STATUS
- Security review opened 2026-01; escalated to CISO in Feb after initial Q&A.
- Key question from CISO (paraphrased): "If your routing layer is under load, do you ever move traffic outside the EU region without us opting in?"
- Another recurring question: "Do you fail closed if the policy evaluator is unavailable?" (They prefer fail closed for residency enforcement. Also asked about how this affects availability/SLA.)

TIMELINE / RECENT ACTIVITIES (CRM NOTES)
- 2026-02-19 (Fireflies ff-91342): Security review focused on EU-only residency + audit evidence. Attendees: HelioBank Security + Platform Eng; Redwood: Lukas Meyer (owner), Markus Klein (SE), Naomi Feldman (Security PM), Marcus Lin (Security Eng), Olga Petrov (GRC).
  - Outcome: They agreed pilot can proceed if we provide (1) sample audit payloads + SIEM mapping, (2) clear statement on cross-region fallback behavior when pinned, (3) written exception process.
- 2026-02-07: Sent draft “EU residency enforcement overview” + early audit event examples. They came back asking for exact field names + retention period for audit events.
- 2026-01-28: Pilot planning call (no recording). They want 30-day pilot with a strict EU-only org configuration and a deliberate negative test (call US endpoint to confirm RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH denial).
- 2025-12-12: Early demo (Hosted + Console). Their Platform Eng asked specifically for "console view of recent violations" and an exportable audit trail.

PILOT PLAN (PROPOSED)
- Phase 1: Hosted API in EU (pinned eu-west). Enable residency enforcement beta flag for their org. Run:
  - 정상 traffic to EU base URL.
  - Intentional calls to US base URL to validate denial + error code + audit event emission.
  - Validate that downstream writes (analytics/log persistence) are EU-bound.
- Phase 2: If token volumes hit threshold, move to Dedicated EU capacity with same policy model. Ensure no hidden cross-region dependencies.

COMMERCIAL / PACKAGING NOTES
- They expect residency controls + audit logs to be part of Enterprise (not add-on). Will consider paid add-on for extended retention, but base SIEM export must be included.
- Budget discussed informally: 250–500k ARR depending on Dedicated sizing.

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS
- Dedicated EU capacity reservation: need to confirm GPU availability window (they asked for "no later than end of Q2").
- Legal: wants contract language specifying in-scope data categories and region boundary guarantee; will ask about subprocessors.
- They requested clarification on whether "EU-only" includes:
  - support access (break-glass) and where support tooling data lives
  - monitoring/telemetry exporters (must remain EU or be anonymized/aggregate-only)

INTERNAL ACTION ITEMS
- Naomi Feldman + Marcus Lin: provide finalized residency enforcement semantics statement (pinned region = no cross-region fallback; exception requires explicit allowance + audit).
- Olga Petrov: compile evidence pack (audit event schema, retention statement, SIEM export mapping).
- Markus Klein: draft pilot success criteria + test plan and share with HelioBank Platform Eng.
- Lukas Meyer: align commercial path (Hosted pilot -> Dedicated EU commit) and confirm decision timeline for April procurement.
